title: Driver
description: The person. The driver app's own record. Added by PRD-2 section 0.16.
x-reads: driverapp: own only, scoped by the driverId claim, field-restricted
x-pii: This doc holds PII. The driver's read rule MUST be field-restricted, not just collection-scoped. A collection-level rule still returns the whole document, and the raw phone would leak through it.

phoneMasked.description: The MASKED phone. The mask is applied at the source by upsertDriver, not by the reader. The raw phone lives in staffPhones/{code}. The shape is PHONE_MASK_FORMAT, 98XXXXXX10. Ten characters, six of them X.

vanId.description: The van allotted to this driver. The device-claim callable checks this, so a driver with a valid code cannot claim a van that is not theirs.

wardIds.description: The driver's allotted wards. Snapshotted into the trip at shift start.

createdAt.description: When the record was created. A SERVER timestamp, written once by upsertDriver. A client that sent it would be forging the audit trail.

createdBy.description: The staffId claim of the staff member who created the record. Written once by upsertDriver from the live staff doc, never from the input.

updatedAt.description: When the record last changed. A SERVER timestamp, rewritten by every upsertDriver update.

updatedBy.description: The staffId claim of the staff member who last changed the record. Rewritten by every upsertDriver update.
